name: set_climate_temperature
description: Set the target climate-control temperature (Celsius) for a seating zone of the car.

zone.description: Seating zone to adjust. One of: driver, passenger, rear, all.

temperature.description: Target temperature in Celsius, between 16 and 30.

name: control_window
description: Open or close one or all of the car windows.

window.description: Window to control. One of: driver, passenger, rear_left, rear_right, all.

action.description: Action to perform. One of: open, close.

name: play_media
description: Start playing media from a given source, optionally a specific title.

source.description: Media source. One of: radio, bluetooth, usb, streaming.

name: lock_doors
description: Lock or unlock all car doors.

lock.description: True to lock the doors, false to unlock.

name: adjust_seat
description: Adjust the recline angle of a specific seat.

seat.description: Seat to adjust. One of: driver, passenger, rear_left, rear_right.

recline.description: Recline angle in degrees, between 0 and 60.

name: set_cruise_control
description: Enable or disable cruise control and optionally set the target speed.

enabled.description: True to enable cruise control, false to disable.

speed.description: Target speed in km/h (30-180), required when enabling.

name: set_navigation_destination
description: Set the navigation system destination address and routing preference.

avoid_tolls.description: Whether to avoid toll roads on the route.

mode.description: Drive mode. One of: eco, comfort, sport, off_road.

name: toggle_defroster
description: Turn the front or rear window defroster on or off.

zone.description: Defroster zone. One of: front, rear.

enabled.description: True to turn the defroster on, false to turn it off.

name: find_charging_station
description: Find nearby EV charging stations within a given radius.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers, between 0 and 100.
